AArch64 compile-time matching, validation and emission. Used by the dynasm macro for arch aarch64 blocks. Mirrors dynasm-rs parser.rs (operand shapes), matching.rs (opdata selection with instruction format mismatch errors) and the static half of compiler.rs (literal range checks at expansion time; dynamic values are re-checked at runtime by aarch64.nim).
